candidates.name: OLiMPiC 1.0 Scanned
reasons: The pinned official source asset contains 159 IMSLP PDFs and 3307 full-page PNGs; 2931 published grand-staff samples map exactly to 788 physical pages and systems, with 30 additional mapping-only systems kept outside the official label set.
Published MusicXML labels only piano grand-staff crops, while the physical pages also contain vocal staves, lyrics, titles and other page content; complete page semantics are therefore unavailable.
Published dev/test score groups and physical IMSLP documents are disjoint. The development train/calibration split was additionally rebuilt to remove two shared physical source documents.
The corpus covers voice-and-piano Lieder with out-of-boundary semantic lyrics rather than all four product configurations.
Distribution of adapted model weights needs an explicit CC-BY-SA attribution/share-alike packaging decision.

candidates.name: Sheet Music Benchmark
reasons: Access requires the user to accept gated terms and share contact information; the agent cannot consent on the user's behalf.
The non-commercial license is not cleared for a generally distributable product.
Lyrics, multi-voice non-keyboard material and other out-of-boundary pages still require page-level filtering.

candidates.name: MusiCorpus 1.0
reasons: The collection is predominantly handwritten, which is outside the frozen boundary.
The published Dolores transcription policy omits directives, lyrics, expression slurs and other expression indications.
The non-commercial share-alike license is not cleared for a generally distributable product.

candidates.name: CollabScore
reasons: The non-commercial share-alike license excludes unqualified product use.
The pinned dataset.json declares 24 works and 184 music pages; one work lacks a MusicXML reference.
None of the 23 MusicXML references passes boundary version 4: ten are excluded only by semantic lyrics, while the remainder also contain non-keyboard multivoice notation or lack a reference.
No IIIF source image was downloaded because the pre-download audit found zero strict in-boundary works and no separate non-commercial-use clearance.
Completeness for supported text, expression and relation families has not been independently audited.

candidates.name: RealScores
reasons: The repository does not provide a clear data license.
The annotations are object-detection ground truth, not complete page MusicXML semantics.
Fourteen pages are far below any release evidence threshold.

candidates.name: OpenScore String Quartets with exact IMSLP mirrors
reasons: All six works contain a second independent voice on a non-keyboard staff and are outside boundary version 4.
No page may be counted until out-of-boundary measures can be excluded with exact page/measure alignment.

candidates.name: KernScores Beethoven piano sonatas with Durand 1915 reference scans
reasons: The repository documents the PDFs as scans of the Durand 1915 source edition and all 100 unique PDFs are image-only, but the repository contains no explicit license file.
The pinned source contains 103 in-boundary Humdrum segments and 101 PDF names, representing 100 unique PDFs and 635 unique scan pages across 32 sonatas.
Two logical movements share one byte-identical multi-movement PDF, and two Humdrum segments have no same-named PDF; exact page ranges require independent adjudication.
Humdrum encodes core musical syntax but does not independently prove completeness for every supported direction, text, relation, visual mark, or page layout object.
No work-disjoint split, independent second annotation, or release freeze has been established.

candidates.name: Polish Scores printed-scan boundary candidates
reasons: The machine audit found 343 printed-scan-linked transcription candidates across 155 physical source groups, predominantly keyboard scores.
All 343 candidates map to 151 cached authoritative MODS records, and none explicitly authorizes the scan asset under CC BY 4.0 even though the transcriptions are CC-BY-4.0.
Physical pages are not yet acquired or uniquely aligned to the candidate transcriptions.
Full-score versus separate-part identity and independent double annotation remain unverified.
